audit.whatIsWrong: Qiyana was called 'he/his' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, loading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t and report[9].t, and the difficulty was built on the claim that she has one dash and no reach.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists qiyana as female. She has TWO dashes: Terrashape (W) covers 1100 units on a flat 7s, and Audacity (E) covers 650 on 11/10/9/8/7. Her R reaches 950. A page that tells the reader 'once Audacity is spent she cannot reach you' is describing a champion that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Difficulty rewritten around both dashes and their real cooldowns, with female pronouns, and around the one thing that genuinely gates her: she has to reach terrain to enchant before her damage is real.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields said she has no long-range tool: whys[4] ('she still lacks a long-range engage tool'), whys[3] ('no gap-closer besides that dash') and spikes[1].text ('short W dash'). content mid said 'Qiyana has no long-range reset'.
audit.why: Terrashape is a 1100-unit dash on a flat 7-second cooldown — that is longer than Aurora's Q range and shorter than any cooldown in Aurora's kit. Supreme Display of Talent reaches 950. Telling a reader she cannot reach them or cannot roam is the single most dangerous error on this page.
audit.corrected: Both dashes stated with ranges and cooldowns in tldr, cooldowns, whys[3], spikes[1], content mid and content late; the roam claim inverted — she roams as fast as you do.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora was given two abilities she does not have. wants.you[0] said 'Hold E's untargetable window', content early said 'she has no way to punish your E's untargetable frames', and whys[5] and spikes[2].text said her items 'don't let her dive you through Spirit Abjuration's untargetability'. The Q was also called 'Twin Drift' in whys[1], spikes[0].text and content early.
audit.why: Aurora's E is 'a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety' — slow and zone flags only, no untargetable. Spirit Abjuration is the passive and it is a heal: 'Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.' There is no untargetability anywhere in Aurora's kit. 'Twin Drift' matches no ability in the file at all. A reader told to hold E for its i-frames will die holding a button that does nothing.
audit.corrected: Every untargetability claim removed and replaced with what the E actually does — a slow plus a backward hop. The fabricated Q name removed, not substituted: the kit file carries no Aurora ability names, so the slot letter and the real 900 range are used.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit — defect-catalogue item 3 — and its content was the false 'once spent she cannot reach you'.
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns, and here it carried a mechanical error instead.
audit.corrected: Audacity 11s at rank 1 down to 7s at rank 5 at 650 range, Terrashape 7s flat at 1100, R 120s at 950, your W 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: content late, whys[5] and spikes[2].text built around 'Riftmaker/Shadowflame' and 'Riftmaker and Shadowflame', while report[8] on the same page says Luden's into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's.
audit.why: Two different first items on one page, and the slash form is placeholder phrasing (defect-catalogue item 7).
audit.corrected: Aligned to the page's own build.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string under an R-zone title, dosFull[2].d was a guarantee line under a wave/roam title, dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string under 'Greed the recast at half HP', and dontsFull[0].d called a single female enemy 'they'.
audit.corrected: All four bodies rewritten to answer their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: LEVEL CHART DISAGREEMENT: phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] all read 'Aurora'.

audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side flipped to 'Aurora' as one atomic group. No win[] edit — win[] is already correct on disk. No phases[N].why reversal needed; they already read Aurora-favouring.

notes: THIS PAGE INVENTED AN ABILITY AURORA DOES NOT HAVE, IN FOUR PLACES. wants.you[0] told the reader to 'Hold E's untargetable window'; content early said Qiyana 'has no way to punish your E's untargetable frames'; whys[5] and spikes[2].text both said her items cannot 'dive you through Spirit Abjuration's untargetability'. Aurora's E is a slow plus a backward hop, and Spirit Abjuration is a heal passive. There is no untargetability anywhere in Aurora's kit. A reader holding E for i-frames dies with the button pressed. All four are replaced with what the E actually does. SECOND FABRICATION: 'Twin Drift' for Aurora's Q, in whys[1], spikes[0].text and content early. This is now the fourth matchup in my slice carrying that invented name — mel, neeko, orianna and qiyana — so it is almost certainly file-wide across aurora and deserves a global sweep beyond this run. I did not substitute a real name anywhere, because the kit file carries no Aurora ability names; I wrote the slot letter and the real 900 range instead. THE MOST DANGEROUS ERROR was the repeated claim that Qiyana has one dash and no reach — 'once spent she cannot reach you' (cooldowns and report[5]), 'no gap-closer besides that dash' (whys[3]), 'she still lacks a long-range engage tool' (whys[4]), 'short W dash' (spikes[1]), 'no long-range reset' (content mid). Terrashape is 1100 units on a FLAT 7 SECONDS — longer than Aurora's Q range, shorter than any Aurora cooldown — and her R reaches 950. Every one of those fields now carries the real number. PACKET SUSPECT RESOLVED: 'Spirit Abjuration's' was flagged as a probable wrong name. The NAME is right — it is Aurora's passive — but the CLAIM attached to it was invented, which is the more serious defect and the one I fixed. BUILD CONFLICT: content late, whys[5] and spikes[2] pointed at Riftmaker while report[8] says Luden's; aligned to report[8].
